decisions.reason: The same message already records the cool, fun, inviting DJ-style identity; the text-and-logo decision is independently owned by the branding Requirement and does not alter this candidate's current attributes.
The branding decision does not change the independently recorded knob styling or measurement markings around the bowls.
Text and logos on the enclosure do not modify the independently established decorative-lighting requirement.
Reference to CAD renderings for machine text and logos does not change spout geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
The source generally requests color as shown in the CAD renderings but establishes no necessary change to the existing beige-and-green color values.
The machine branding decision does not affect bowl capacity, depth, or the accepted bowl-size reference.
The CAD renderings are used as a visual reference for branding; the source does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverable.
The text-and-logo decision has no effect on whisk selection, dimensions, attachment, or operating position.
The branding modification does not alter splash-control targets or mitigation methods.
Adding text and logos to the machine does not change the finalized wiring-plan deliverable.
The branding decision does not affect bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance.
The source does not change access to internal systems, service operations, or serviceable fluid routing.
